environment.description: Application deployed on an EC2 instance running Amazon Linux 2, behind an Application Load Balancer with default listener rules (forward all to target group). The Flask app runs as the 'appuser' (uid 1000) via systemd unit. No additional middleware or request filtering is configured. The ALB has no AWS WAF WebACL associated. The instance security group allows inbound on port 443 from 0.0.0.0/0.

config.load_balancer: ALB with default forwarding rule, no WebACL attached
